title: Mole Current: Rust Core
description: Current deterministic Rust core mapped onto the Melee movement spine. Colors show parity status against the Melee reference while SDL remains a visual/runtime shell.

known_gaps: Full Melee accessory model scale and exact platform asset rendering remain pending.

nodes.label: Turn

Basic standing-turn dash-out is delayed one exported tick after the profile flip frame, matching the Slippi post/pre boundary, while Smash Turn and the UCF source hook retain their same-frame dash-out behavior. Exact source helper identity and Turn collision still need deeper coverage.

physics: Rust now models the input-callback-then-physics order for movement paths entering Turn: Wait, Walk, and Dash transitions stage Turn friction in the same frame.
Before has_turned, Turn action checks use turn_facing_after like the source's temporary facing flip; shield/jump/dash logic keeps the restored-facing path.
Turn latch/debug fields are deterministic state and exposed through runtime traces.
Dash->Turn applies Dash IASA x54 first, then Turn's general grounded ft_80084F3C friction before position and gr_vel commit.
Walk/Wait carried gr_vel entering Turn receives the same Turn friction before any next-frame dash-out.

nodes.label: Dash
nodes.notes: Rust owns extracted PlCo dash facts: x0/x4 deadzones, x8/xC tap thresholds, x3C dash threshold, x40 tap window, x44/x48/x4C IASA windows, x54 Dash IASA velocity decay, source-shaped entry delta, tap-start early-Dash gating, Falcon Dash action-script cmd_var[0] timing, cmd-var-gated Dash-to-Run, source animation-completion fallback to Wait, and moonwalk-like payload/relay tests without a Moonwalk state. Grounded horizontal movement now stages source-shaped gr_vel, xE4_ground_accel_1, and xE8_ground_accel_2 equivalents: xE4 contributes to same-frame translation and ground velocity, while Dash-entry xE8 commits after translation and mv.co.dash.x0 suppresses the first ordinary Dash_Phys acceleration tick.
known_gaps: Human moonwalk feel is still short/not chainable in playtest; ledger should isolate whether remaining gap is input timing, stick path capture, Dash live accel, follow-up state timing, or another decomp update-order path.

nodes.label: Squat
nodes.notes: Rust has explicit crouch startup, profile-owned startup duration, and source-style platform-pass arming through the shared Pass gate/countdown. Exact animation data still needs extraction.

nodes.label: Pass
nodes.notes: Rust common drop-through platform state. Guard/GuardOn/GuardReflect enter through the held-shield pass gate; Squat arms platform_pass_pending/platform_pass_timer before entering the same Pass state. Pass seeds source x46C vertical velocity, then the shared airborne fall step applies gravity before translation, matching ftCo_Pass_Phys -> ft_80084DB0. Pass animation completion now enters Fall at the generated Falcon action 209 frame count, matching ftCo_Pass_Anim -> ftCo_Fall_Enter while continuing through the ordinary airborne path for that frame.
known_gaps: Pass state exists for the common movement path; character-special routes that call ftCo_8009A184 remain future per-character work.

nodes.label: GuardOn

nodes.label: KneeBend
nodes.notes: Rust has Falcon 4f jumpsquat, short-hop release tracking, profile-owned full/short hop takeoff forces, and source-shaped grounded-to-air order: grounded IASA entries into KneeBend now run ftCo_KneeBend_Phys/ft_80084F3C on the same frame, while takeoff scales the prior grounded self_vel/gr_vel without an extra takeoff-frame friction tick. KneeBend_Anim enters JumpF/JumpB, same-frame Jump_IASA may accept fresh airborne actions, and the first Jump physics tick skips ordinary air drift/gravity. ECB coverage maps KneeBend through ftCo_SM_Kneebend/action-table slot 15; Captain Falcon's DAT points that slot at the Landing figatree bytes, but the decomp motion-state identity remains KneeBend.

nodes.label: Run
nodes.notes: Rust has sustained run with extracted x58 run threshold, extracted x38 Run-to-TurnRun threshold, and source-shaped x430 ordering: Run_Anim decrements the no-interrupt counter before Run_IASA. Remaining run exits stay partial until the full callback surface is audited.
known_gaps: Run exits remain marked partial until deeper Melee parity review covers every release/turn/brake timing path.

nodes.label: RunDirect

The source RunDirect IASA handoff into Run and release fallback to Wait are now modeled for injected/diagnostic RunDirect state identity; a normal gameplay entry path into RunDirect has not been found in the local decomp.
known_gaps: No normal source path that enters RunDirect was found by searching ftCo_MS_RunDirect, RunDirect, and numeric state-table references in the local decomp.
The RunDirect-specific mv.ca.specials.grav gate is treated as eligible only for the injected/diagnostic state identity until a real source entry initializes that motion var.

known_gaps: TurnRun remains partial until every source callback side path outside grounded locomotion is audited.
